# OSO CDC Connector for Oracle Database
> Open-source (Apache-2.0) Kafka Connect source connector that captures change data from Oracle Database through LogMiner, by OSO. Built for correctness and operability: no silent data loss, a durable transaction journal, bounded memory, resumable snapshots, multi-PDB capture, exactly-once delivery, a preflight doctor and drop-in migration from Confluent and Debezium.

## Core documentation
- [Introduction](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/): what the connector is and the status of each capability
- [Getting started](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/getting-started): Docker Compose and Strimzi labs, installation, first connector
- [Database setup](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/database-setup): ARCHIVELOG, supplemental logging and the mining user generated by oracle-cdc-doctor setup-sql

## Reference
- [Configuration](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/reference/configuration): every cdc.* property
- [Error classes](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/reference/error-classes): CDC-nnnn codes and their runbooks
- [oracle-cdc-doctor](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/operations/doctor): preflight rules and exit codes

## Migration
- [From Debezium](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/migration/from-debezium)
- [From Confluent](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/migration/from-confluent)
